method_log.name: sample_pairwise
method_log.rationale: Naive baseline. No shrinkage. N=1239, D=20 (N/D=62), so sample is feasible but noisy in extreme tails.

method_log.name: ledoit_wolf_oracle
method_log.rationale: Ledoit-Wolf 2003 — optimal linear shrinkage toward identity. Robust when N/D moderate.

method_log.name: ledoit_wolf_constcor
method_log.rationale: Ledoit-Wolf 2004 constant-correlation shrinkage simplified — KR equity homogeneous-cor structure suits this target.

method_log.name: gerber_rmt
method_log.rationale: Gerber 2022 robust statistic + Marchenko-Pastur RMT noise filter. Robust to fat-tails (Eom-Kaizoji-Scalas 2019 KR fat-tail).

method_log.name: pairwise_shrunk
method_log.rationale: Fixed-shrinkage toward diagonal (α=0.20). Conservative fallback if LW unstable.

method_shopping_log.selection_rationale: Selected ledoit_wolf_oracle on basis of (1) condition number 14.51 (lowest among PSD candidates with cond<500), (2) academic legitimacy (Ledoit-Wolf 2003/2004), (3) appropriateness for KR equity moderate-N/D regime (N=1233 days, D=20 tickers, ratio 61.6).
